The reference values for a Normal Random Glucose test in an average adult are 70-140 mg/dL (4.4-7.8 mmol/i). between 140-200
mg/L (78-11.1 mmol/l) is considered pre-diabetes, and › 200 mg/dL is considered diabetes according to ADA guidelines (you should
visit your doctor or a clinic for additional tests)
